title: A query whose search fails is dropped from the results without an error
close_reason: Fixed in b3e738a. SuffixArray::search_many returns one Result per query, and the CLI passes each error on with ?.

notes.author: Jeb Rosen/f3787cc2
notes.text: Still present on dev at 657e16d, where the fix is not in the history: `SufrFile::suffix_search` in `libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs:881` collects with `flat_map`, so a query whose `search` returns `Err` (from `get_range` at `sufr_search.rs:135`) is dropped. Not reproduced on dev.
